Management that protects the asset.

Great property management is more than collecting rent. It is the disciplined management of people, property, finances, compliance, and every detail in between.

Tenant Acquisition & Screening

Market vacant units, attract qualified applicants, conduct appropriate background, credit and employment checks, and manage lease execution.

Rent Collection & Financial Management

Collect monthly rent, manage late-payment processes, oversee operating budgets, and provide clear income and expense reporting.

Property Maintenance & Repairs

Coordinate inspections, manage repair requests, source reliable vendors, and respond to emergency maintenance needs.

Legal & Regulatory Compliance

Support compliance with applicable housing regulations, notices, documentation, and formal legal processes when required.

Move-In & Move-Out Inspections

Document property condition at the start and end of each tenancy to support transparent maintenance and security-deposit accounting.

Questions, answered.

How do I book a property inspection?

Open any unit in Available Rentals, choose Book Inspection, pick a time, enter your details and pay any viewing fee.

Is there a viewing fee, and is it refundable?

Fees are set per property and may be free. Refund terms are shown before you pay.

Which payment methods can I use?

Mobile Money, card, bank transfer, or pay at viewing where the property allows it.

Do you manage properties for overseas owners?

Yes. Owners get online access to statements, documents and maintenance updates.

Can I list my own property with Dala?

Yes. Use the consultation form below and we will propose a management plan.
